evidence.locator: PDF p4 Figure S2, caption; main article p712 Materials and methods
evidence.finding: WM9 diffuse diffraction pattern is compared with crystalline San Giovanni hemimorphite. Caption assigns circled peaks to quartz and dashed reference positions to hemimorphite. WM9 measured at ESRF BM08. Supports poor long-range order with accessory quartz, not pure crystalline hemimorphite or a phase fraction.

evidence.locator: PDF p5 section S5; p6 Figure S3; p3 R-squared definition; main article p716 Table1
evidence.finding: WM9/WM13/WM20/WM23 paired fits show R-squared misfit 0.01 with Si shell and 0.02 without. Authors attribute improvement to Si shell and report no significant gain from further shells. This is source-reported fitted local structure; no raw spectra or independent refitting. Main Table1 fixes biomineral first-shell coordination to four. S5 calls the fit figure S2, whereas displayed figure and contents call it S3.

evidence.locator: PDF p7 Table S1; main article p717 Organic matrix and biomineral formation
evidence.finding: Table contains 14 sample-keyed LOI measurements in percent w/w, range9.50–15.12; WM9=13.62, WM13=11.94, WM20=10.05, WM23=9.50. LOI is not a direct organic-carbon/organic-mass assay, mineral yield or phase fraction. Main-paper organic-mass range is approximate interpretation using NMR sensitivity and LOI. No separate raw worksheet or LOI heating protocol supplied in this deposit.

evidence.locator: PDF pp2–3 section S1, p4 sections S2–S3, p5 section S4
evidence.finding: Analytical methods and complementary FTIR/NMR explanation. Section S4 assigns carbonate signal to hydrozincite and reports prior-study interpretation of sparse detrital fragments separate from EPS. This must not be relabelled as the quartz assignment in XRD Figure S2 or a phase fraction.
